resources.string: PocketBioacoustics needs microphone permission to capture lossless FLAC, ALAC, WAV, and AIFF audio segments.
Shows active recording timer and segment controls
Start a continuous session in Studio. Segments auto-save as lossless FLAC, ALAC, WAV, or AIFF files at your chosen interval.

After nearly 10 years of working in bioacoustics, one thing became clear to me: bioacoustic monitoring is still not accessible to many people. Dedicated passive acoustic recorders can be expensive, creating a barrier for students, enthusiasts, and researchers who want to get started.

PocketBioacoustics was built to change that. It turns an Android phone into a bioacoustic recorder with features such as acoustic triggering, pre-recording capture, autonomous scheduling, lossless recording, GPS tagging, and live spectrograms, making wildlife sound recording more accessible to everyone.
My hope is simple: make background wildlife recording easy, affordable, and accessible so that more people can listen to nature, collect data, and engage with the fascinating world of bioacoustics.
🌿 Happy soundscape exploring. Every sound tells a story. Start listening. 🎙️
